description: A full brief that needs a component the model must look up (Voronoi): gh_find_component, then adds by the returned componentGuid.
userPrompt: Make a 2D Voronoi paving pattern: 30 random points inside a 20 x 20 m rectangle, with the Voronoi cells clipped to it. Inputs: point count 10 to 50 and a random seed (mine). Rule: cells stay inside the rectangle. Principle: a random cellular partition for paving. Evaluation: keep the cell count equal to the point count. Build it.
